        position=torch.arange(0,max_len,dtype=torch.float).unsqueeze(1)
        div=torch.exp(torch.arange(0,d_model,2).float()*(-math.log(10000.0)/d_model))

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn


class PositionalEncoding(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d_model: int, max_len: int = 5000):
        super().__init__()
        pe = torch.zeros(max_len, d_model)
        position = torch.arange(0, max_len, dtype=torch.float).unsqueeze(1)
        div_term = torch.exp(
            torch.arange(0, d_model, 2, dtype=torch.float)
            * (-math.log(10000.0) / d_model)
        )
        pe[:, 0::2] = torch.sin(position * div_term)
        pe[:, 1::2] = torch.cos(position * div_term)
        self.register_buffer("pe", pe.unsqueeze(0))


class RecoveredModel(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.embedding = nn.Linear(64, 128)
        self.pos_encoder = PositionalEncoding(128)
        self.transformer_encoder = nn.TransformerEncoder(
            nn.TransformerEncoderLayer(
                d_model=128, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=256, batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=3,
        )
        self.transformer_decoder = nn.TransformerDecoder(
            nn.TransformerDecoderLayer(
                d_model=128, nhead=8, dim_feedforward=256, batch_first=True
            ),
            num_layers=1,
        )
        self.output_layer = nn.Linear(128, 64)

    def forward(self, src: torch.Tensor, tgt: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
        src_emb = self.embedding(src) + self.pos_encoder.pe[:, : src.size(1)]
        memory = self.transformer_encoder(src_emb)
        tgt_emb = self.embedding(tgt) + self.pos_encoder.pe[:, : tgt.size(1)]
        decoded = self.transformer_decoder(tgt_emb, memory)
        return self.output_layer(decoded)


def main():
    weights = torch.load("/app/weights.pt", map_location="cpu")
    data = torch.load("/app/dataset.pt", map_location="cpu")
    src, tgt = data["src_sequences"], data["tgt_sequences"]

    model = RecoveredModel()
    model.load_state_dict(weights, strict=True)
    model.eval()

    with torch.no_grad():
        original_pred = model(src, tgt)
        original_loss = nn.functional.mse_loss(original_pred, tgt).item()

    for name, param in model.named_parameters():
        param.requires_grad_(name.startswith("output_layer."))

    with torch.no_grad():
        src_emb = model.embedding(src) + model.pos_encoder.pe[:, : src.size(1)]
        memory = model.transformer_encoder(src_emb)
        tgt_emb = model.embedding(tgt) + model.pos_encoder.pe[:, : tgt.size(1)]
        features = model.transformer_decoder(tgt_emb, memory)

        design = torch.cat(
            [features.reshape(-1, 128), torch.ones(features.numel() // 128, 1)], dim=1
        )
        targets = tgt.reshape(-1, 64)
        solution = torch.linalg.lstsq(design, targets).solution

        model.output_layer.weight.copy_(solution[:128].T)
        model.output_layer.bias.copy_(solution[128])

        updated_pred = model(src, tgt)
        updated_loss = nn.functional.mse_loss(updated_pred, tgt).item()

    print(f"Original MSE: {original_loss:.8f}")
    print(f"Updated MSE:  {updated_loss:.8f}")

    model.eval()
    scripted = torch.jit.script(model)
    torch.jit.save(scripted, "/app/model.pt")

    reloaded = torch.jit.load("/app/model.pt")
    reloaded.load_state_dict(weights, strict=True)
    reload_mse = nn.functional.mse_loss(reloaded(src, tgt), tgt).item()
    print(f"Original weights reload MSE (sanity check): {reload_mse:.8f}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
